svg.title: Sequence 7 — Giving online through the institution's PayHere merchant

g.text: Sequence 7 — Giving online through the institution's PayHere merchant
institution Active? merchant enabled? need open?
open the merchant secret (AES-GCM, per institution)
order by OrderId; merchant of that order
UPDATE OnlinePayments … WHERE Id = @id AND Status <> 'Paid'
(row lock: a repeated notify waits, then finds it paid)
close a Pending order only (a Paid one is never undone)
